title: Senior Application Security Specialist
description:
**Location:**
Pune (Hybrid)

**Experience:**
5+ years (about 70% software development, 30% security)

About the role

This is a development-first security role. About 70% of the work is engineering: you will fix vulnerabilities in application code, upgrade vulnerable components, and build the tooling and automation that keep issues from coming back. The other 30% is security testing across our web apps and APIs. You own each fix end to end, from the finding to a merged, tested change.

What you will do

Development and remediation

* Fix vulnerabilities directly in application code, in whatever language or framework the application uses, and add tests that prove the fix.
* Fix root causes, not single instances: build shared validation, output encoding, parameterized queries, and authorization checks that remove whole classes of vulnerabilities.
* Upgrade vulnerable libraries, frameworks, and third-party components, resolve breaking changes, and keep builds and tests passing.
* Build internal security tooling and automation: scanner integrations, triage and reporting scripts, and checks that catch issues before release.
* Integrate SAST, DAST, and SCA tooling such as Aikido into CI/CD pipelines, and tune the rules to cut noise.
* Fix infrastructure and configuration issues: web server and TLS settings, cloud IAM and network rules, container and Kubernetes configuration, infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD pipeline hardening.
* Where code or infrastructure is owned by another team, raise the change yourself as a pull request and drive it to merge.

Security testing

* Test web applications and APIs for exploitable vulnerabilities.
* Review code and design for flaws in authentication, authorization, session handling, data flows, and secrets management.
* Run and tune vulnerability scans across applications, hosts, or cloud accounts, and prioritize findings by exploitability and business impact alongside CVSS.
* Retest fixes and close findings only when the vulnerability is confirmed resolved.

Reporting and communication

* Write clear findings and fix notes with reproduction steps, evidence, risk rating, and the change made.
* Agree on realistic remediation timelines with engineers, and share secure coding patterns so the same issues stop recurring.

What you bring

Experience

* 5+ years total: approx. 3.5 years building and shipping production software as a developer, and approx. 1.5+ years of hands-on security work such as VAPT, application security, or secure code review.
* A track record of fixing security issues in code.

Development expertise

* Production-level depth in at least two of: Java, C#/.NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, PHP, Go, Swift, or Kotlin. Comfortable reading and changing code in languages you know less well.
* Able to land a correct, tested fix in an unfamiliar codebase without breaking existing behavior.
* Web and API development: REST and GraphQL services; authentication with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and JWT; session management; databases and ORMs.
* Unit and integration testing, Git-based workflows, pull requests, and code review.
* CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Working knowledge of Nginx, Apache, IIS, and TLS configuration.
* Scripting in Python, Bash, or PowerShell to automate testing and remediation.

Communication

* Clear written findings and the ability to explain risk and trade-offs to engineers and business stakeholders.

Nice to have

* Web and API: manual testing with Burp Suite Professional; OWASP Top 10 and ASVS; injection, authentication and session flaws, access control (IDOR/BOLA), SSRF, and OAuth and JWT weaknesses.
* Secure code review: spotting vulnerable patterns in code and using SAST and SCA results to find and fix real issues.
* Built security tools, Burp extensions, or custom SAST rules (for example, Semgrep or CodeQL).
* Threat modeling and secure design review experience.
* Familiarity with compliance evidence requirements (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS) as they relate to vulnerability remediation.

What success looks like

* Vulnerabilities reach merged, tested fixes within agreed timelines.
* Recurring vulnerability classes decline because fixes address root causes.
* The tooling and automation you build catch issues before release and cut manual triage.
* Development teams see you as a fellow engineer who ships fixes alongside them.
* Cloud misconfiguration and patch exposure windows stay short.

title: L2 Security Specialist
description:
**Role: L2 Security Specialist**

**Location:**
Pune / Hyderabad

**Experience Level:**
3 to 5 years

**Position Overview**

We are seeking an analytical and vigilant
**L2 Security Specialist**
to join the cybersecurity operations team supporting the
**Project**
. The infrastructure is a complex hybrid environment spanning native
**Microsoft Azure**
,
**Azure VMware Solution (AVS)**
, and
**on-premises data centers**
.

In this role, you will be the core technical guardian of the project’s security boundaries. You will secure workloads across public cloud, virtualized VMware software-defined data centers (SDDCs), and legacy physical hardware. Your mission is to implement zero-trust network configurations, manage hybrid identities, ensure strict vulnerability governance, and lead the technical response to security events across all environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Hybrid Network Security & Micro-segmentation**

* **NSX-T & Cloud Firewalls:**
  Manage and audit distributed firewall rules within
  **VMware NSX-T**
  for the Azure VMware Solution (AVS) cluster, as well as native Azure Network Security Groups (NSGs) and Application Security Groups (ASGs).
* **Micro-segmentation Strategy:**
  Define and implement granular micro-segmentation policies to isolate application workloads across native Azure, AVS guest environments, and on-premises physical servers.
* **Cross-Boundary Encryption:**
  Ensure all transit data moving over VPNs, ExpressRoute, and Azure Global Reach is securely encrypted using IPsec or TLS protocols.

**2. Identity & Access Governance**

* **Hybrid Identity:**
  Administer and monitor identity syncs and federations between Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and on-premises Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS).
* **Access Control (RBAC):**
  Enforce the principle of least privilege by configuring and maintaining Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) across Azure subscriptions, AVS vCenter instances, and on-premises virtualization hosts.
* **MFA & Conditional Access:**
  Implement and audit Conditional Access Policies, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and Privileged Identity Management (PIM) for project personnel.

**3. Vulnerability & Threat Management**

* **Vulnerability Scanning:**
  Schedule and evaluate regular vulnerability scans across hybrid VM operating systems, containerized workloads, and hypervisor management interfaces using tools like Microsoft Defender for Cloud or Qualys.
* **Patch Compliance Governance:**
  Work closely with the DevOps and Infrastructure teams to track patch compliance and prioritize remediations for CVEs affecting virtual machines in Azure and AVS.
* **Secrets Management:**
  Securely manage certificates, connection strings, API keys, and cryptographic keys using
  **Azure Key Vault**
  and on-premises hardware security modules (HSMs).

**4. Security Monitoring & Incident Response**

* **SIEM Management:**
  Collect, analyze, and query security logs (using KQL) inside
  **Azure Sentinel**
  (SIEM/SOAR) and on-premises syslog servers to detect lateral movements or anomalies.
* **Incident Containment:**
  Act as the Tier-2 incident responder for security alerts, following playbook actions to isolate compromised virtual machines (e.g., placing VMs in isolated NSX-T segments).
* **Compliance Auditing:**
  Perform regular compliance audits against frameworks such as CIS Benchmarks, NIST, or ISO 27001 to ensure the hybrid infrastructure meets organizational policies.

**Qualifications & Skills**

**Required:**

* **Experience:**
  3+ years of experience in Cyber Security, Security Operations (SecOps), or Cloud Security.
* **Cloud Security Knowledge:**
  Hands-on experience securing workloads in
  **Microsoft Azure**
  (utilizing Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Network Security Groups, and IAM).
* **Virtualization Security:**
  Solid understanding of VMware security concepts (vSphere hardening, vCenter access controls) and
  **VMware NSX-T**
  firewall configurations (essential for securing
  **AVS**
  workloads).
* **Identity Management:**
  Experience managing hybrid authentication models (Azure AD / Active Directory).
* **Log Analysis:**
  Proficiency in querying log data (such as using Kusto Query Language -
  **KQL**
  in Log Analytics or Azure Sentinel).

**Preferred:**

* **Certifications:**
  **Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500)**
  ,
  **CompTIA Security+**
  , or
  **VMware Certified Professional - Security (VCP-SEC)**
  .
* **Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Security:**
  Familiarity with static code analysis tools (such as Checkov or tfsec) to scan Terraform templates for security flaws.

title: Engineer II - Vulnerability Detection
description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.
  
  
****The Product Group:****
IOT Security Product Group is focussed on developing products and solutions for ICS/ OT and other IOT verticals like Healthcare. The charter for the team is to use CrowdStrike's platform capabilities and threat intelligence, and build modules and features, integrate with partner products and platforms to establish ourselves as the leading security vendor in this space.
  
  
****About The Role:****
This role will have a solid understanding of the IOT ICS domain. He/ she will understand the Purdue model, the assets, criticality and the data pertaining to security and its sources to provide accurate asset visibility, vulnerabilities. This involves understanding the domain and systems and software like SCADA servers, HMI, EW, DCS and understanding how adversaries may exploit these resources to advance their modes of interest. This person will be required to identify the data sources, gather the data, analyse the data, identify its criticality, and also automate simple tasks. They will also be responsible for troubleshooting issues with current data and making enhancements.

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**Metro Global Solution Center (MGSC)**
is internal solution partner for METRO, a €31.6 Billion international wholesaler with operations in more than 30 countries. The store network comprises a total of 623 stores in 21 countries, of which 522 offer out-of-store delivery (OOS), and 94 dedicated depots. In 12 countries, METRO runs only the delivery business by its delivery companies (Food Service Distribution, FSD).
  
  
HoReCa and Traders are core customer groups of METRO. The HoReCa section includes hotels, restaurants, catering companies as well as bars, cafés and canteen operators. The Traders section includes small grocery stores and kiosks. The majority of all customer groups are small and medium-sized enterprises as well as sole traders. METRO helps them manage their business challenges more effectively.
  
  
MGSC, location wise is present in Pune (India), Düsseldorf (Germany) and Szczecin (Poland). We provide HR, Finance, IT, Strategy, Branding & Business operations support to 31 countries, speak 24+ languages and process over 18,000 transactions a day. We are setting tomorrow’s standards for customer focus, digital solutions, and sustainable business models. For over 10 years, we have been providing services and solutions from our two locations in Pune and Szczecin. This has allowed us to gain extensive experience in how we can best serve our internal customers with high quality and passion. We believe that we can add value, drive efficiency, and satisfy our customers.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Embed application security controls into CI/CD pipelines to provide accurate, actionable, and timely feedback to engineers.

**Job Title: Divisional Risk and Control Specialist, VP**

Corporate Banking is a technology-driven business operating in an increasingly real-time, interconnected environment, where clients expect seamless services, integrated platforms and trusted access to data. Corporate Bank (CB) Technology supports this ambition through a complex global ecosystem of business-critical applications, platforms, data services and infrastructure. We are seeking an experienced technology risk professional to play a key role in our Proactive Risk Testing Programme, delivering rigorous, risk-based assessments across this landscape. The role requires the ability to develop a deep understanding of applications and their end-to-end architecture, critically evaluate the design and effectiveness of implemented technology controls, and identify both existing and emerging IT and Information Security risks. Working closely with senior technology, business and control stakeholders, you will translate complex technical observations into clear risk insights, strengthen the testing strategy and drive sustainable improvements that enhance the resilience, security and control environment of mission-critical technology services.
  
  
**What We’ll Offer You**
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
  
  

* Best in class leave policy
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

**Your Key Responsibilities**
Reporting locally to the India Corporate Bank Technology Control Testing Lead in Pune and functionally to the CB Technology Testing Lead based in London, you will:
  
  

* Lead and deliver risk-based, end-to-end IT and Information Security assessments across the Corporate Bank (CB) Technology landscape, independently assessing the design, implementation and operating effectiveness of key controls.
* Develop an in-depth understanding of business services and their supporting technology, including application and platform architecture, infrastructure, databases, operating systems, cloud services, networks, interfaces, APIs, data flows, batch and real-time processing, and third-party dependencies.
* Perform technical deep dives across applications, platforms, databases and infrastructure to identify and assess existing and emerging IT and IS risks, control weaknesses, root causes, systemic themes and potential impacts on confidentiality, integrity, resilience and regulatory compliance.
* Assess technology lifecycle risks and controls including design, development and production considering aspects such as access management, security, operations and resilience.
* Apply professional judgement to define risk-based testing scope, develop risk and control matrices, determine sampling and testing approaches, analyze technical evidence, and produce clear, well-supported conclusions in line with testing standards.
* Challenge technology and control owners constructively, communicate complex technical risks in business terms and support agreement on pragmatic and sustainable remediation actions.
* Identify cross-application and thematic risks, emerging technology threats, control automation opportunities and opportunities to use data analytics and continuous monitoring to improve assurance coverage.
* Partner with Technology Application Teams, Architects, Engineering, Information Security, Control Owners, the Divisional Control Office, Group Audit and other stakeholders to promote transparency and sustainable risk mitigation.
* Contribute to the ongoing enhancement of risk-based testing methodologies, standards, documentation and quality assurance, while providing guidance and technical coaching to colleagues where required.

**Your Skills And Experience**

* Extensive experience in IT/Cyber security assessments, technology risk, information security, controls assurance or related discipline, including leading complex reviews in a large, regulated organization.
* In-depth understanding of enterprise technology and application architecture, including cloud and on-premises infrastructure, databases, operating systems, networks, APIs, middleware, data integration and third-party services.
* Demonstrable ability to analyze architecture diagrams, data flows, configurations, system logs, access models, vulnerability information and other technical evidence to identify control gaps and assess their business and risk impact.
* Strong knowledge of IT General Controls and Application Controls, cyber security, secure software development, identity and access management, privileged access management, network and cloud security, vulnerability management, data and cryptographic protection, security monitoring, incident management, operational resilience and technology lifecycle management.
* Awareness of emerging technology and risk areas, including cloud security, DevSecOps, automation, artificial intelligence, open-source software, third-party concentration and evolving cyber threats.
* Experience applying recognized frameworks and standards such as COBIT, NIST, ISO 27001, ITIL and relevant regulatory expectations; professional certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CRISC, or equivalent is desirable.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with the confidence to challenge senior stakeholders and translate complex technical matters into concise, risk-based findings and practical remediation actions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality outcomes.
* Experience working in Agile and DevOps environments; knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and its control environment would be an advantage.

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**
**How We’ll Support You**

* Coaching and support from experts in your team

description:

Area(s) of responsibility

title: Principal Test Engineer
description:

.

 

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a

to partner directly with the Sonicwall Firewall development team. In this high-impact technical role, you will lead feature testing, complex defect reproduction, test plan architecture, and automation development across critical Sonicwall Firewall networking and security components.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* ****Dev Partnership & Defect Triage:****
  Work closely with firmware and software developers to reproduce intricate customer and field issues, isolate root causes, and verify bug fixes.
* ****Test Strategy & Planning:****
  Architect end-to-end test strategies, author detailed test plans, and design comprehensive functional, system, and regression test suites.

  Drive the complete Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC)—identifying, filing, prioritizing, and tracking defects to closure in an Agile environment.

**Core Skills & Requirements**

* ****Domain & SQA Experience:****
  10+ years of software quality assurance experience in the networking and network security domain for enterprise network products, appliances, or firewalls.

* ****Domain & Network Security Expertise:****

+ Deep understanding of L2–L7 networking concepts: TCP/IP, IP routing, NAT, VLANs, and stateful packet filtering.
+ Strong expertise in Network Security and Next-Generation Firewalling: Deep Packet Inspection (DPI), SSL/TLS, IPSec/SSL VPN, and access rules.

* ****Test Automation & Scripting:****

+ Strong hands-on programming/scripting proficiency in
  **Python**
  (OOP principles, test framework development, and REST API automation).
+ Experience utilizing traffic generators and test tools (e.g., IXIA, Spirent, Scapy, tcpreplay).

* ****Troubleshooting & Issue Reproduction:****

+ Advanced problem-solving skills with proven ability to capture and analyze network packets (Wireshark, tcpdump).
+ Experience analyzing system logs, core dumps, and device diagnostics to triage complex system/firmware behaviors.

* ****Methodologies & Processes:****

+ Thorough mastery of SDLC, STLC, defect lifecycles, and Agile/Scrum practices.
+ Experience designing system testbeds simulating enterprise network topologies.

* ****Professional Experience:****

+ 8+ years of test engineering and automation experience in the networking/network security domain (with a track record of driving test execution at a senior/lead/PE level).

**Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical mindset with high ownership of product quality and reliability.
* Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills to interface effectively with development, product management, and sustaining teams.
* Proven ability to work effectively across geographically distributed teams.

title: Cloud AI Security - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber**
Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Job Title:**
SeniorConsultant - Cloud AI Security
  
  
Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte could be the place for you. Traditional security programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure and support technology innovation required by the business. Join Deloitte's Cyber Cloud AI Security team and become a member of the largest group of cybersecurity professionals worldwide.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
As a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant, you will lead and support client engagements focused on securing AI, generative AI, and ML workloads across cloud platforms. You will bring deep experience across cloud security, AI security architecture, governance, compliance, platform controls, and monitoring to help clients design, assess, and implement secure AI capabilities at scale. You will be expected to contribute to solutioning and client delivery, and provide actionable recommendations across the AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, model development, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, and retraining.
  
  
Responsibilities as a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant will include:
  
  

* Drive the design and implementation of AI security solutions within cloud environments aligned to client business objectives, enterprise architecture, regulatory expectations, and security requirements.
* Execute AI security assessments for cloud-hosted AI/ML and GenAI workloads, evaluating controls against frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001.
* Define and implement AI security controls across identity, access, network segmentation, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, workload protection, and secure configuration management.
* Support threat modeling and security architecture reviews for AI and GenAI solutions, including risks related to prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, sensitive data exposure, model misuse, and insecure tool or connector usage.
* Design and review secure AI architectures spanning model endpoints, APIs, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, vector stores, plugins, agent frameworks, orchestration layers, and external tool integrations.
* Support secure deployment and configuration of cloud-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Google Vertex AI.
* Implement and review platform-specific controls such as private connectivity, encryption with customer-managed keys, tenant isolation, access restrictions, content safety controls, and service-native logging and monitoring capabilities.
* Drive DevSecOps, MLOps, and MLSecOps integration efforts by embedding policy validation, secrets handling, secure model promotion, compliance checks, and security testing into CI/CD and ML pipelines.
* Define and implement secure AI lifecycle controls across data ingestion, model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, incident response, drift review, and retraining, including protections against data poisoning, model tampering, and supply-chain risk.
* Support AI governance and compliance activities including model inventory, risk classification, approval workflows, traceability, documentation standards, and control mapping aligned to NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001.
* Support clients in implementing responsible AI and model governance controls related to data protection, access control, model usage restrictions, prompt security, content filtering, and audit readiness.
* Execute AI security posture management efforts using cloud-native tooling, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, and related controls to identify misconfiguration, data exposure, anomalous model activity, and policy violations.
* Support AI-specific monitoring and incident response by helping define detections, alerts, escalation paths, and remediation activities for suspicious prompt behavior, agent abuse, unauthorized model access, and sensitive data leakage.
* Conduct or support AI security testing activities including misuse-case testing, control validation, prompt attack testing, model guardrail validation, and red-team support for AI-enabled applications.
* Work directly with client stakeholders across security, cloud engineering, DevOps, data, ML engineering, privacy, risk, and architecture teams to translate requirements into implementable designs and remediation plans.

**The team**
Deloitte Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory’s Cyber Risk Services practice.
  
  
**Required:**

* 7+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity consulting, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or closely related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading or owning workstreams in client-facing security engagements.
* Experience designing, assessing, or implementing security controls for cloud-hosted applications, platforms, or AI/ML environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform and working knowledge of the other leading platforms: AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI security concepts, including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage, secure model access, agent security, and responsible AI fundamentals.
* Experience implementing cloud security controls across IAM, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Bash, and PowerShell.
* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and secure engineering practices, including policy validation, secrets handling, and continuous compliance.
* Familiarity with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, Mythos, Anthropic, and Vertex AI.
* Familiarity with AI governance and security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred:**

* Experience conducting AI security assessments, architecture reviews, control design, and remediation programs across AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud.
* Deep hands-on experience with identity and access management, including AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and Google Cloud IAM.
* Experience designing governance and guardrails for cloud AI environments using services such as AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, Azure Policy, Security Command Center, and equivalent policy enforcement capabilities.
* Experience with cloud-native monitoring and security tooling such as AWS Security Hub, CloudTrail, AWS Config, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and Google Security Command Center.
* Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, vulnerability management, container security, and posture management tools supporting AI workloads.
* Experience with prompt security, content safety, model guardrails, and AI runtime monitoring for generative AI applications.
* Exposure to AI red teaming, misuse-case testing, prompt attack validation, or adversarial testing of LLM-enabled applications.
* Experience securing containerized, API-driven, and agent-based AI applications.
* Knowledge of privacy, legal, and data governance considerations relevant to AI workloads, including data residency, retention, sensitive data handling, and auditability.
* Experience establishing AI governance processes such as AI inventory, model classification, approval gates, traceability, and documentation aligned to AI risk management practices.
* Relevant certifications such as:
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate
* Google Cloud Certified – Professional Cloud Security Engineer
* Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate

Job description:
  
  
Job Description

Lead the design, delivery, governance, and continuous improvement of cybersecurity programs and services, driving innovation, operational excellence, and business growth across global markets.

* Lead End-to-End Cybersecurity Programs across security platform deployments, cloud security transformations, vulnerability management initiatives, and service transition projects.
* Derive program for Security Solutions aligned with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices to enhance the organization's security posture.
* Drive Security Service Innovation by developing and enhancing cybersecurity service offerings, frameworks, and delivery methodologies.
* Establish Governance and Operational Models to ensure effective program execution, risk management, quality assurance, and service excellence.
* Collaborate with Business and Technical Stakeholders to define security roadmaps, solution architectures, and strategic cybersecurity initiatives.
* Evaluate and Adopt Emerging Technologies through research, assessment, and integration of new cybersecurity tools, platforms, and operating models.
* Provide Technical Leadership and Advisory Services for large-scale security transformation programs, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and customer expectations.
* Enable Knowledge Transfer and Capability Building by mentoring teams, sharing industry best practices, and strengthening internal cybersecurity competencies.
* Manage Global and Multi-Country Delivery Engagements while ensuring compliance with contractual commitments, governance standards, and customer requirements.
* Improve Service Scalability and Business Growth by enhancing operational efficiency, customer confidence, service competitiveness, and supporting expansion into international markets.

Mandatory Skills: Infrastructure Security Consulting
  
.

Experience: >10 YEARS
  
.

Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end-to-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA - as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

title: Cyber Security Trainer
description:
We are looking for an experienced and passionate Cyber Security Trainer to deliver industry-oriented training in CEH, WAPT, SOC, and CHFI. The candidate should have strong technical expertise, practical lab experience, and the ability to train students and working professionals using real-world scenarios and hands-on exercises.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Deliver theoretical and practical training in CEH, WAPT, SOC, and CHFI.
* Conduct hands-on sessions using industry-standard cybersecurity tools and lab environments.
* Demonstrate ethical hacking techniques, vulnerability assessment, and penetration testing methodologies.
* Train students in Security Operations Center (SOC) processes, SIEM tools, threat detection, and incident response.
* Teach digital forensics, evidence collection, malware analysis fundamentals, and cybercrime investigation techniques.
* Develop training materials, practical assignments, projects, and lab exercises.
* Conduct assessments, evaluate student performance, and provide technical guidance.
* Prepare students for cybersecurity certifications, technical interviews, and industry requirements.
* Stay updated with emerging cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and security technologies.

**Technical Skills Required**

* CEH – Certified Ethical Hacker
* Ethical hacking methodologies and penetration testing fundamentals
* Network scanning, enumeration, and vulnerability assessment
* Tools: Nmap, Metasploit, Wireshark, Burp Suite
* Web application and network security fundamentals
* WAPT – Web Application Penetration Testing
* OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities
* SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF, SSRF, and authentication flaws
* Manual and automated web application testing
* Tools: Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nmap
* Vulnerability identification, exploitation in authorized labs, and report writing
* SOC – Security Operations Center
* Security monitoring, threat detection, and incident response
* SIEM tools such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, or QRadar
* Log analysis, alert triage, and threat hunting
* MITRE ATT&CK framework and security incident handling
* Basic malware analysis and endpoint security monitoring
* CHFI – Computer Hacking Forensic Investigator
* Digital forensics and cybercrime investigation
* Disk, file system, and memory forensics fundamentals
* Evidence acquisition, preservation, and chain of custody
* Log analysis and forensic reporting
* Tools such as Autopsy, FTK, and Wireshark

**Required Skills**

* Strong hands-on knowledge of cybersecurity tools and technologies.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and classroom management skills.
* Ability to explain complex security concepts through practical demonstrations.
* Experience in conducting lab sessions and real-world scenario-based exercises.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Relevant certifications such as CEH, CHFI, Security+, or other recognized cybersecurity credentials.
* Experience in cybersecurity training, penetration testing, SOC operations, or digital forensics.
* Practical experience with enterprise security tools and security lab environments.

**Interested candidates can share their CV at: careers@sevenmentor.com**

title: Cyber Security Manager
description:
SysTools is a Managed Security Services Provider. We are based out of Pune, New Delhi, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Mumbai and Bengalaru

**Role Description**

* The Cyber Security Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Pune City, responsible for leading and managing the customer's cybersecurity posture across systems, networks, and applications.
* This role involves overseeing security operations, monitoring threats, coordinating incident response, and ensuring compliance with relevant security standards and best practices.
* Day-to-day tasks include conducting risk and vulnerability assessments, defining and implementing security policies, guiding SOC/NOC activities, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to remediate security issues.
* The Cyber Security Manager will also mentor and support security analysts, evaluate new security tools and technologies, prepare regular security reports, and contribute to continuous improvement of SysTools’ managed cybersecurity services.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Cybersecurity and Information Security, with experience in designing and implementing enterprise-wide security frameworks.
* Candidates should possess skills in Network Security, including securing network infrastructure, firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, and monitoring network traffic for threats.
* Candidates should possess skills in Application Security, focusing on secure software development practices, code review, and protection of web and cloud applications.
* Candidates should possess skills in Vulnerability Assessment, including scanning, risk prioritization, remediation planning, and reporting on security findings.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field; relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CEH, or OSCP are highly beneficial.
* Proven experience in managing SOC operations, incident response, and security governance in a medium to large IT environment.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams, work effectively on-site in Pune City, and collaborate with stakeholders at multiple levels.

title: Resilience Recovery Engineer - Software
description:
We are seeking an experienced Resilience Recovery Engineer - Software to join the Resilience Operations team, working alongside CTO Platform Engineering. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain cyber resilience and recovery tooling that enables teams across Barclays to autonomously manage protection and recovery operations. You'll work on a distributed microservices platform that orchestrates complex workflows across multi-infrastructure environments, integrates with enterprise governance systems, and handles real-time event streaming and state management. You will partner with infrastructure teams, security teams, and application owners to deliver solutions that reduce recovery times, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen the bank's overall resilience posture. As a senior engineer, you'll own key architectural decisions, mentor team members, and contribute to evolving our platform's scalability, reliability, and security.
  
  
To be successful as a Resilience Recovery Engineer - Software , you should have experience in:
  
  
  

* React or Angular front-end development (responsive, accessible UIs).
* Go backend development, including REST API design and service integration.
* GitLab CI/CD pipelines (build, test, scan, deploy automation).
* Containerised applications on Kubernetes/OpenShift (deploy, run, troubleshoot).

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills Include**

* TypeScript and modern front-end tooling and patterns.
* API security and integration: OAuth2/OIDC/JWT, mTLS; data stores and messaging.
* Helm and Infrastructure as Code, monitoring and logging.
* Being a thought leader and innovator with experience in cloud and containerisation technologies.
* Proven track record of delivering transformation at scale, moving legacy applications to cloud native micro-services architecture.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, communication skills and interaction with a diverse range of stakeholders, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Vulnerability Remediation.- Technical Specialist-Cloud & Infra Engg
description:
Area(s) of responsibility
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Security Hardening & Misconfiguration Remediation Specialist to drive security configuration improvements across enterprise environments. The role involves identifying, analyzing, and remediating system misconfigurations while ensuring minimal business disruption. The candidate will work closely with application owners, infrastructure teams, and clients to strengthen security posture in alignment with industry standards.
  
  
**Preferred Experience**
2–5 years of experience in Security Hardening, Configuration Management, or Security Operations.
  
  
Experience in enterprise environments with structured change management processes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Security Hardening & Misconfiguration Management
  
  
Analyze security misconfigurations across servers, endpoints, and infrastructure components.
  
  
Drive remediation activities in coordination with infrastructure and application teams.
  
  
Evaluate operational and business impact before implementing configuration changes.
  
  
Understand and analyze application dependencies prior to remediation actions.
  
  
Document exceptions and risk acceptance with proper justification and approvals.
  
  
Vulnerability & Configuration Governance
  
  
Support vulnerability management processes (knowledge of vulnerability lifecycle is an added advantage).
  
  
Interpret security baselines and compliance standards such as NIST and CIS Benchmarks.
  
  
Review and remediate insecure configurations, policies, and legacy protocols.
  
  
Ensure RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) is properly implemented and aligned with least privilege principles.
  
  
Change & Stakeholder Management
  
  
Present remediation plans in CAB (Change Advisory Board) meetings.
  
  
Coordinate change implementation through ITSM tools such as ServiceNow (SNOW).
  
  
Engage with clients and internal stakeholders to provide remediation updates and clarifications.
  
  
Provide clear risk communication and remediation timelines.
  
  
**Technical Analysis & Implementation**
Perform Windows OS security configuration reviews.
  
  
Implement and validate registry-level changes and system hardening controls.
  
  
Execute and analyze Windows commands and scripts for configuration validation.
  
  
Identify and validate insecure services, permissions, and system-level misconfigurations.

title: Senior Platform Architect-1
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Platform Architect-1
  
  
**Overview**
Infrastructure Design Services is a team of Technology Architects and Engineers responsible for the analysis and design of the infrastructure framework to fit the application, platform or system needs in-line with MasterCard's operational standards and principles.
  
  
Infrastructure Design Services is engaged from the beginning of the analysis and design phase to work with the application team(s) and other critical teams within Mastercard to ensure that the completed infrastructure and application architecture aligns with MasterCard’s security, scalability and availability standards.
  
  
Infrastructure Design Services' primary deliverable is the TAD (Technical Architecture Document) which details the infrastructure design for the application, platform or system.
  
  
This job requires experience in internet fundamentals related to web servers, application servers, internet security and other internet technologies.
  
  
This job actively performs designing and delivering internet infrastructure solutions that satisfy member, product, service and backbone requirements.
  
  
Have you ever worked with Microsoft Visio to design middleware infrastructure from the ground up?
  
  
Can you interface with the user(s), application team(s), etc., and all other stakeholders in order to determine their (evolving) needs and requirements?
  
  
Can you generate the highest level of system requirements, based on the given requirements and other constraints?
  
  
Can you ensure that this set of high level requirements is consistent, complete, correct, and operationally defined?
  
  
Role
  
  

* Generating requirements, together with other architects, engineers, application team(s) and user(s), to determine that all of the high level requirements have been met.
* Generating products such as TADs, technical documents, logical flows, and models to keep the user(s), architects and the engineers constantly up to date and in agreement on the application, system or platform to be provided as it is evolving.
* Ensuring that all architectural products and products with architectural input are maintained in the most current state and never allowed to become obsolete.
* Resolve internet architectural and operational problems impacting infrastructure and product availability and performance globally.
* Research and evaluate new technology for possible deployment in MasterCard’s internet infrastructure.
* May assume lead and total accountability for ongoing regional projects as assigned; including responsibility for planning; time and cost control; resource utilization and implementation.
* Implement, manage and support internet infrastructure components while leveraging current standards and best practices.
* Perform problem diagnosis; performance tuning; capacity planning and configuration management for MasterCard internet components.
* Assure system stability and future compatibility by monitoring production execution of all relevant systems.

**All About You**

* Thorough knowledge and understanding of network, operating system principles and web middleware.
* Thorough knowledge in one or more core functions related to internet infrastructure design and/or web administration
* Advanced knowledge of load balancers and web application firewalls
* Working knowledge of Database technologies.
* Working knowledge of cloud technologies
* Must be high-energy, proactive, detail-oriented and able to function under pressure in an independent environment.
* Must have a high degree of initiative and self-motivation and demonstrate the ability to drive results.
* Strong communication skills both verbal and written and strong relationship and collaborative skills and organizational skills with the ability to work as a member of matrix based diverse and geographically distributed project team.
* Willingness and ability to learn and take on challenging opportunities is critical.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture principles and Network Micro-segmentation.
* Experience working with YAML based deployments

**Skills/Abilities**

* Displays leadership and initiative.
* Detailed oriented and customer obsessed.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to multi-task and prioritize efforts.
* Ability to pick up new technologies at a quick pace and learn on-the-go
* Ability to work with team members located in multiple geographies
* Displays excellent collaborative skills with cross-functional teams.
* Provide positive customer service to internal business partners.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Manager, Application Security
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**Summary**
OpenGov is seeking an experienced Manager of Application Security to lead our growing AppSec team. This role blends technical expertise with people leadership, driving a secure-by-design culture across our engineering organization while mentoring and empowering a high-performing team.
  
  
You will oversee the strategy and execution of application security initiatives, embedding industry-leading standards such as OWASP into our development lifecycle. The ideal candidate is collaborative, approachable, and an excellent communicator, capable of building trust with engineers, product leaders, and executives alike.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead and mentor the Application Security team to drive engagement, growth, and technical excellence.
* Build and execute the organization’s application security roadmap to strengthen the security posture of all product suites and APIs.
* Champion secure development practices by embedding OWASP ASVS and OWASP Top 10 guidance into coding standards, architecture reviews, and threat modeling.
* Oversee the selection, deployment, and integration of AppSec tools (e.g., SAST, DAST, SCA, ASPM) into CI/CD pipelines.
* Partner with Engineering, DevOps, and Product to ensure secure coding, design reviews, and vulnerability management processes are followed.
* Report on risk metrics, remediation progress, and program effectiveness to senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and fun team culture that inspires innovation and continuous improvement.
* Serve as the AppSec subject-matter expert for internal audits, customer reviews, and compliance (SOC 2, GovRAMP, FedRAMP, etc.).

**Required Qualifications**

* 7+ years of combined experience in Application Security, Software Engineering, or related fields; 3+ years leading or managing security teams.
* Deep understanding of OWASP ASVS, OWASP Top 10, and secure software development practices.
* Hands-on experience with modern AppSec tools and frameworks (SAST, DAST, SCA, API security, ASPM).
* Proven ability to build and motivate high-performing teams, with strong mentoring and coaching skills.
* Excellent communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management abilities.
* Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to influence across technical and non-technical teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a SaaS or cloud-native software company.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and security automation.
* Knowledge of compliance and regulatory frameworks relevant to software companies (SOC 2, GovRAMP, FedRAMP, etc.).
* Certifications such as CSSLP, CISSP, OSWE, or similar AppSec credentials.

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Cyber Operate - Pentesting - Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
We are seeking a Consultant– AI/ML/DevSecOps / Application Security with strong hands-on delivery experience in SAST, SCA, and DAST to embed security across the software development lifecycle. This role focuses on implementing and operating application security tooling in CI/CD pipelines, executing application security assessments (including API security), triaging and prioritizing findings, enabling remediation, and driving secure-by-design engineering practices across cloud-native and enterprise applications. SAST, SCA, and DAST remain foundational AppSec capabilities, and the role is positioned accordingly with an emphasis on measurable delivery outcomes (tool onboarding, pipeline coverage, risk reduction, and remediation closure).
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Integrate, configure, and optimize static application security testing (SAST), software composition analysis (SCA), and dynamic application security testing (DAST) tools in continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, including quality gates and exception workflows.
* Perform security assessments across application code, open-source dependencies, REST and GraphQL application programming interfaces (APIs), cloud-native workloads, containers, and Kubernetes environments to identify vulnerabilities, exposed secrets, configuration gaps, and software supply-chain risks.
* Triage scan results, validate findings, prioritize vulnerabilities based on exploitability and business impact, and provide remediation guidance, compensating controls, and verification steps.
* Facilitate threat modeling and security design reviews; translate risks into secure design requirements, test cases, acceptance criteria, and engineering backlog items.
* Implement DevSecOps controls, including infrastructure-as-code scanning, secrets detection, container image scanning, policy-as-code, software bills of materials, and build and release integrity controls.
* Design and build artificial intelligence agents and agentic workflows for application security automation; assess AI/ML and generative AI application risks; and deliver client reports, dashboards, trend analysis, and implementation roadmaps.

**The team**
Deloitte's Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes:
  
  

* Managing Identity Lifecycle
* Security Operations
* Threat Intelligence
* Application Security
* Business Transformation
* Continuous Compliance

**Location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Kolkata**
**Shift Timings: Rotational**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or another technical discipline.
* 3-6 years of hands-on application security or DevSecOps experience, including operation of SAST, SCA, and DAST capabilities in CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with at least one application security tool: Checkmarx, Veracode, Fortify, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, Mend/WhiteSource, or Black Duck.
* Experience integrating security controls into Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps, including pipeline templates, quality gates, and exception workflows; experience using Python or Bash for application security automation.
* Experience performing REST or GraphQL API security testing, including authentication and authorization testing, input validation, rate limiting, broken object-level authorization, and broken function-level authorization; experience with vulnerability triage and remediation validation.
* Experience conducting threat modeling and security architecture reviews for modern applications, microservices, or APIs.
* Experience designing and building AI agents or agentic workflows for security or engineering use cases, including tool or function calling, multi-step orchestration, logging, guardrails, and human validation.

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience applying the OWASP Application Security Verification Standard to define or validate application security requirements.
* Experience implementing container or Kubernetes security, infrastructure-as-code scanning, secrets detection, or policy-as-code controls.
* Experience implementing software or AI/ML supply-chain controls, including software bills of materials, model bills of materials, artifact signing or verification, dependency pinning, build provenance, model registries, or data and model lineage.
* Experience applying artificial intelligence security guidance, including OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications, MITRE ATLAS, National Institute of Standards and Technology AI Risk Management Framework, or Google Secure AI Framework.

description:
**Company Description**
Assent empowers manufacturers and distributors with the intelligence to build sustainable products, meet global compliance requirements and drive better business outcomes.

Our hybrid work model enables teams to collaborate across regions while staying connected to the communities where they live and work. As a certified B Corporation, we meet rigorous standards of social and environmental performance, transparency, and accountability, reflecting our commitment to creating lasting value for our customers, our people, and the planet.

Our commitment to People, Culture & Community (PCC) is rooted in building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing team. We recruit and retain team members with a range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, while fostering a culture of belonging where all Assentees are respected, supported, and empowered to contribute.
  
  
As we continue to embed AI into how we work, we do so thoughtfully, enhancing human potential, supporting better decision-making, and prioritizing appropriate oversight, privacy, and fairness.
  
  
At Assent, we value your privacy and are committed to maintaining transparency in how we handle your personal information. As part of our talent acquisition and management processes, we may use AI technologies to support activities such as resume screening, candidate communication, and talent analytics.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
The Senior Cloud Operations Specialist is a senior technical owner for the stability, security, governance, and resilience of Assent's enterprise AWS environment and SaaS production systems. The role combines hands-on cloud operations with solution architecture, technical leadership, and sound risk-based decision making across a large multi-account AWS estate.
  
  
Working within the SaaS Product Infrastructure group, this individual partners with Engineering, Product, Corporate Security, and IT to design and operate secure, highly available cloud services. The successful candidate works independently at a high level, turns business and technical requirements into practical solutions, and constructively challenges decisions that introduce unnecessary risk, operational burden, or architectural debt.
  
  
This role follows a strict code-first and least-privilege operating model. Infrastructure changes are codified, peer-reviewed, and delivered through approved pipelines. Privileged access is exceptional, time-bound, auditable, and used only when required.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Architecture Technical Leadership and Decision Making**

* Lead the design and delivery of secure, scalable, resilient, and supportable AWS solutions from initial requirements through production operation.
* Translate business, security, compliance, and operational requirements into architecture decisions, implementation plans, and reusable platform patterns.
* Evaluate technical options and make clear, risk-based recommendations that balance security, reliability, maintainability, delivery speed, and cost.
* Question assumptions and respectfully challenge designs or delivery approaches that conflict with enterprise standards, least-privilege principles, reliability objectives, or long-term platform health.
* Participate in architecture and design reviews, document key decisions and tradeoffs, and ensure operational readiness before production adoption.
* Act as a senior technical escalation point, lead complex infrastructure initiatives, and coach team members through design and operational decisions.

**AWS Platform Governance Identity and Privileged Access**

* Own and continuously improve Assent's AWS multi-account environment using AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, organizational units, account lifecycle controls, guardrails, and Service Control Policies.
* Architect and operate AWS IAM Identity Center, IAM roles and policies, permission sets, trust relationships, permission boundaries, federation, and cross-account access patterns.
* Apply least privilege by default. Ensure elevated access is approved, time-bound where supported, protected by strong authentication, logged, regularly reviewed, and separated from day-to-day identities.
* Maintain controlled break-glass access and prevent shared credentials, unmanaged access paths, unnecessary standing privilege, and unreviewed administrative changes.
* Lead account provisioning, compliance assessments, access reviews, drift detection, and remediation across the AWS organization.
* Partner with Corporate Security on identity governance, audit readiness, cloud control design, and the implementation of enterprise security requirements.

**Enterprise AWS Networking**

* Design, operate, and troubleshoot enterprise AWS network architectures across accounts and regions, including VPCs, subnets, route tables, security groups, network ACLs, and shared network services.
* Own connectivity and traffic-flow patterns using services such as Transit Gateway, VPC peering, PrivateLink, VPN, Direct Connect, Route 53, Elastic Load Balancing, API Gateway, and CloudFront.
* Design secure ingress, egress, segmentation, DNS, and service-to-service connectivity patterns using AWS Network Firewall, AWS WAF, VPC endpoints, flow logs, and centralized inspection where appropriate.
* Diagnose complex routing, name resolution, load-balancing, firewall, latency, and cross-account connectivity issues and drive permanent corrective action.
* Maintain current network diagrams, traffic-flow documentation, connectivity standards, and recovery procedures.

**Infrastructure as Code Automation and Delivery**

* Provision and govern AWS platform resources through Terraform using reusable modules, secure remote state, controlled workspaces, and maintainable multi-account patterns.
* Use GitHub Actions as the primary delivery mechanism for infrastructure and governance changes, with peer review, validation, security checks, approvals, and traceable deployment records.
* Uphold a no unmanaged changes standard. Use AWS console access only for approved operational needs, and codify or reconcile any necessary emergency change promptly.
* Build automation with Python, PowerShell, Bash, Lambda, Ansible, Semaphore, or similar tools to reduce manual effort, enforce consistency, and improve recovery time.
* Review infrastructure code and automation for security, reliability, maintainability, and alignment with enterprise standards.

**Cloud Operations Reliability and Incident Response**

* Operate and improve core AWS services across compute, containers, databases, storage, messaging, DNS, content delivery, security, and monitoring.
* Install, configure, secure, patch, and troubleshoot Linux and Windows workloads in cloud environments.
* Establish effective monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, and automated remediation using CloudWatch, OpenSearch or Elasticsearch, New Relic, PagerDuty, or comparable platforms.
* Lead or support high-severity incident response, communicate clearly under pressure, restore service safely, and coordinate across technical and business teams.
* Conduct root-cause analysis and ensure corrective actions address underlying technical and process failures rather than only immediate symptoms.
* Participate in the on-call rotation and planned off-hours work required to support production infrastructure.

**Security Compliance Resilience and Operational Ownership**

* Maintain enterprise standards for encryption, key management, audit logging, configuration compliance, vulnerability remediation, and evidence collection using services such as KMS, CloudTrail, and AWS Config.
* Support internal and external audits and provide clear evidence of cloud controls, access governance, and operational processes.
* Design, implement, and test backup, business continuity, disaster recovery, and multi-region resilience capabilities.
* Create and maintain accurate documentation for cloud architecture, governance controls, operational procedures, automation workflows, and support handoffs.
* Take end-to-end ownership of assigned platforms and initiatives, surface risks early, and follow decisions through implementation and operational acceptance.

**Qualifications**
**Minimum Requirements**

* 7 or more years of relevant experience in cloud operations, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or systems administration, including substantial hands-on responsibility for enterprise AWS environments.
* Proven long-term ownership of a multi-account AWS organization using AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, and AWS IAM Identity Center.
* Deep experience with enterprise AWS governance, including organizational design, account provisioning, Service Control Policies, guardrails, configuration compliance, and drift remediation.
* Advanced knowledge of AWS identity and access management, including least privilege, privileged-access controls, federation, cross-account access, permission sets, IAM policies and roles, and emergency access practices.
* Strong AWS networking experience, including multi-account and multi-region network design, routing, DNS, load balancing, private connectivity, segmentation, and network security controls.
* Strong Terraform experience, including reusable modules, multi-account deployment patterns, secure remote state in Amazon S3, code review, testing, and lifecycle management.
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining GitHub Actions pipelines for infrastructure deployment, policy enforcement, and operational automation.
* Demonstrated ability to architect solutions and carry them through implementation, validation, documentation, and production support.
* Sound judgment in ambiguous or high-pressure situations, with the confidence to challenge proposals, explain risk clearly, and make defensible technical decisions.
* Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
* Working knowledge of Linux and Windows administration in production cloud environments.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams, security stakeholders, leadership, and vendors.
* Ability to work independently as part of a globally distributed team and to participate in on-call and planned off-hours work.
* University degree, college diploma, or equivalent practical experience.
* AWS certification at the Associate level or higher, or equivalent demonstrated enterprise AWS expertise.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Account Factory for Terraform or Customizations for AWS Control Tower.
* AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Advanced Networking Specialty, or Security Specialty certification.
* Experience with ECS or Fargate, EC2, RDS for PostgreSQL or SQL Server, S3, SQS, SNS, SES, Amazon MQ, API Gateway, CloudFront, and Route 53.
* Experience with enterprise configuration management and automation using Ansible, Semaphore, or comparable tooling.
* Experience with OpenSearch or Elasticsearch, New Relic, PagerDuty, Datadog, SolarWinds DPA, or comparable observability and performance platforms
* Familiarity with Auth0 or other enterprise identity providers.
* Experience designing and testing disaster recovery across AWS accounts and regions.
* Experience in enterprise SaaS, regulated industries, or high-security cloud environments.

**Additional Information**
**Life at Assent**
**Wellness:**
We believe that you and your family’s well being is important. As a result, we offer vacation time that increases with tenure, comprehensive benefits packages (details vary by country), life leave days and more.
  
  
**Financial Benefits:**
It’s not all about the money – well, it’s a little about the money. We understand that financial health is important and we offer a competitive base salary, a corporate bonus program, retirement savings options and more.
  
  
**Life at Assent:**
There is purpose beyond your work. We provide our team members with flexible work options, volunteer days and opportunities to get involved in corporate giving initiatives.
  
  
**Lifelong Learning:**
At Assent, curiosity is not only valued but encouraged. You will receive professional development days that are available to you the day you start.
  
  
At Assent, we are committed to growing and sustaining an environment where our team members feel included, valued, and heard. Our diversity and equal opportunity practices are guided and championed by our Diversity and Inclusion Working Group and our Employee Resource Groups (ERGs).
  
  
Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion includes recruiting and retaining team members from diverse backgrounds and experiences, and fostering a culture of belonging where all team members are included, treated with dignity and respect, promoted on their merits, and placed in positions to contribute to business success.
  
  
If you require assistance or accommodation throughout any part of the interview and selection process, please contact talent@assent.com and we will be happy to help.
